glossary_feedback.observation: With no system-actor name for the referral source or target (D-11), the app-connection page coins 'referral platform' for whichever server hosts the referral (provider EHR, CBO system or CP), which readers can confuse with the CP's aka 'community resource referral platform'; the self-referral page likewise says the CBO 'functions as the Referral Target system'.

The CP entry describes an intermediary-operated platform for health care organizations, yet its aka 'community resource referral platform' is what the Referral source entry uses for the self-referral platform the referral source itself operates; the self-referral page needs that platform without an intermediary, so the entry should say the aka can be a referral source's system.

The self-referral page offers a direct referral light variant where the referral target has no FHIR server, and the app-connection page has a light target connect to a CP as its 'referral source'; the Direct/Indirect referral entries (both parties have FHIR server APIs) and the fixed source/target roles fit neither (D-12).

In self-referral the individual identifies their own 'health-related social need', which is patient-prioritized and so reads as a social need, while the glossary equates HRSN with social risk; a note on which term to use for self-identified needs would help.
